verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:1
verses.text: Shawng lam hta Karai Kasang gaw sumsing lamu hte ga dak hpe hpan da nngai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:2
verses.text: Ga dak gaw hpan n sam n nga, katsing katsang rai nga ai; tsang madang a ntsa hta sinup sinak rai nga nna, Karai Kasang a Vanya gaw hpanghkawng a ntsa hta yu kawan nga ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:3
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Hku hkyeng rai u ga, ngu tsun yang, hku hkyeng rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:4
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw hku hkyeng hpe kaja ai hpe mu nna, hku hkyeng hte sinuk sinak hpe garan da nngai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:5
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw hku hkyeng hpe Shani ngu nna, sinuk sinak hpe Shana ngu shaga ai. Shana hte shani gaw shawng lam a shani rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:6
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Hkyinkhang a hka shingra hta ntsa lam hte ka-ang lam garan u ga, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:7
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw lamu hkyinkhang hpe galaw nna, hka hpe garan da nngai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:8
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw lamu hkyinkhang hpe Sumsing Lamu ngu shaga ai. Shana hte shani gaw jahkru lam a shani rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:9
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Sumsing lamu la-u hta nga ai hka yawng shara langai hta zup u ga, ga kran dan u ga, ngu tsun yang, dai zawng rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:10
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw ga kran hpe Ga Ntsa ngu, hka zup shara hpe Panglai ngu shaga ai. Karai Kasang gaw kaja ai hpe mu ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:11
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Ga Ntsa hta lap katsing, tum lu ai nmai, tsi lu ai hpun ni tu u ga, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:12
verses.text: Ga Ntsa gaw lap katsing hte nmai tsi ni hpe shapraw ai. Karai Kasang gaw kaja ai hpe mu ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:13
verses.text: Shana hte shani gaw masum ni a shani rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:14
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw sumsing lamu hta jan hte shata nmai shagan ni hpe chyeju jaw nna Shani hte Shana garan u ga, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:15
verses.text: Sumsing lamu hta ga ntsa hpe htoi ya u ga rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:16
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw htoi kababa lahkawng: jan hpe shani up u ga, shata hpe shana up u ga, shagan ni hpe galaw da ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:17
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw dai ni hpe sumsing lamu hta ga ntsa hpe htoi ya u ga shatung da nngai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:18
verses.text: Shani hte shana hpe up nna hku hkyeng hte sinuk garan u ga. Karai Kasang gaw kaja ai hpe mu ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:19
verses.text: Shana hte shani gaw mala ni a shani rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:20
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Hka hta asak rawng ai nga ni myi-hpawp rai u ga, pyien ai u ni sumsing lamu hta pyien u ga, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:21
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw panglai nga kaba ni hte asak rawng ai u hte nga yawng hpe hpan da nngai. Karai Kasang gaw kaja ai hpe mu ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:22
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw dai ni hpe shamani ya nna, Nga ni panglai hta jat wa mu, pyien ai u ni ga ntsa hta jat wa mu, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:23
verses.text: Shana hte shani gaw manga ni a shani rai wa ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:24
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Ga ntsa hta yam dusat, ga ginwang dusat, du kaba dusat ni shapraw u ga, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:25
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw dusat myu yawng hpe hpan da nngai. Karai Kasang gaw kaja ai hpe mu ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:26
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Anhte a sumla hte bung ai Masha hpe hpan sa ga, dai wa gaw panglai nga ni, lamu u ni, dusat yawng hpe up u ga, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:27
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw Shi a sumla hte masha hpe hpan da ai; la hte num hpe hpan da nngai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:28
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw shanhte hpe shamani ya nna, Masha jat wa mu, ga ntsa hpe hpring u ga, up u ga, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:29
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw, Yu u, ga ntsa hta tu ai nmai tsi hte tum lu ai hpun yawng hpe nanhte a lu sha a matu jaw nngai, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:30
verses.text: Dusat yawng hte lamu u yawng a matu lap katsing hpe lu sha a matu jaw nngai, ngu tsun ai.

verses.name: Ningpawt Ningchang 1:31
verses.text: Karai Kasang gaw Shi galaw da ai yawng hpe yu yang, grai kaja ai hpe mu ai. Shana hte shani gaw hkru ni a shani rai wa ai.
